{{Otheruses|Formidable}}
The '''''Formidable''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] that was involved in the [[Battle of Turkana/Legends|Battle of Turkana]]. It ended up severely damaged alongside the ''[[Ajax]]'' after Rebel starfighters unloaded their proton torpedoes onto their bridge shields.
